column9: The full git map is captured through runAnalyzer without overriding maxBuffer. That helper uses execFileSync, whose default stdout limit is 1 MiB. For repositories whose map exceeds that limit, execution fails with ENOBUFS and the collector reports available:false despite successful analysis. The top option cannot prevent this because truncation happens only after parsing the full output.

The documented adjustForAi option is never read or passed to the analyzer. Both true and false use the same unadjusted contributor commit counts, so callers requesting an AI-adjusted bus factor silently receive the unadjusted result.
